svg.text: Source/Plugin · created by the host, lives as long as the plugin instance, works with no window open
1 Settings: the saved state, edited on the message thread · Source/Plugin
ValueTree · every setting and the corpus path
2 Corpus: analysed on a worker thread, published to the audio thread
Source/Plugin · starts one analysis job at a time
Source/Audio · the corpus the audio thread reads
3 Live engine: runs inside processBlock, never allocates · Source/Audio
4 Output channels: written on the audio thread, read elsewhere
back to the host: the input is cleared
and the grains are mixed in
Source/Plugin · made by createEditor, lives while the window is open
Load, Analyse again, Save, Load analysis,
one dot per slice, the live puck, flashes;
the mouse plays the nearest dot;
holds the published corpus by shared_ptr
Timer at 60 Hz: drains the bridge
plus the settings and colourPresets ValueTree handles
A box inside a box is a member its container owns. The dashed arrow is the editor's references into the processor; nothing points back.
